summary: Verified all three UI changes requested by the German user against the preview deployment. Backend: 8/8 pytest checks pass; only seed-portugal-messi is present in GET /api/tips (Häcken parlay is fully removed at seed and via startup delete_many). Frontend: Rate Wall on landing page renders the Portugal & Messi card with the Portuguese flag 🇵🇹 (data-testid='tip-flags') and the new 'Einsatz 25,00 €' / 'Gewinn 875,00 €' row for the single-tip card. No compile overlay, no console errors, no runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: startup() correctly issues `await db.tips.delete_many({'id': 'seed-hacken-parlay'})` before calling seed_showcase(), and seed_showcase() no longer inserts the Häcken parlay. Idempotent + backwards-compatible with older DBs still holding the record.

RateWall.jsx tipFlags() builds a haystack from country/home_team/away_team/league (+ leg.match/league) and matches against NATION_FLAGS/LEAGUE_FLAGS, falling back to 🌍 for GLOBAL_KEYS. Cap at 5 flags. Sensible and inexpensive.
Single-tip branch (~line 259) now renders Einsatz/Gewinn row conditionally on tip.stake || tip.potential_return — matches the parlay branch behaviour. Symmetry between the two branches is good.

Minor (non-blocking): The card image the user uploaded contains a printed 'Tax 5,3% 46,38 €' line — as flagged by the main agent this is inside the user's screenshot, not editable. The card now correctly writes the true Gewinn 875,00 € underneath, so viewers see the right value. Consistent with the request.

Minor (non-blocking): During navigation I saw warnings 'No routes matched location /wall' — the Rate Wall is only reachable via the landing route, not /wall. Not part of this bug fix, just an observation for future SEO/deep-linking work.
